# Unsafe inventory

<!-- generated by scripts/unsafe_inventory.py; do not edit by hand -->

Rust migration Phase 10 M2 ([ADR-004](adr/ADR-004-unsafe-policy.md)).
`unsafe` tokens per workspace crate over `src/**/*.rs`, comment lines
excluded (the count the ROADMAP's Phase 8 block first recorded by hand),
with the crate-level `unsafe_code` attribute checked against the ADR-004
tier table in the script. Regenerate with `python3 scripts/unsafe_inventory.py`;
`--check` fails when the doc is stale or a crate's attribute or
`allow(unsafe_code)` module set departs from the table.

Tiers: **forbid** = pure crate, `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`; **deny** =
crate-wide `#![deny(unsafe_code)]` with the listed `allow` module(s);
**open** = concentrated location (FFI, Vulkan, harness), governed by the
workspace `unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn = deny` and
`clippy::undocumented_unsafe_blocks = deny` lints.
